member.name: P:SharpEmu.Logging.BuildInfo.IsOfficialRelease
member.summary: Whether this build is an official release: a Release-configuration CI build from the canonical repository, produced by a push to main or a manual workflow dispatch (matching the CI release job). All other builds (pull requests, forks, feature branches, and local/Debug builds) are considered unofficial.

member.name: P:SharpEmu.Logging.BuildInfo.Banner
member.summary:
The multi-line banner, e.g.
SharpEmu UNOFFICIAL f11ac59 — https://github.com/sharpemu/sharpemu
Built from branch "main" of "sharpemu/sharpemu" by GitHub Actions workflow run https://github.com/sharpemu/sharpemu/actions/runs/123.
Official release builds drop the UNOFFICIAL tag. Falls back to a local-build line when no CI provenance is present.
